description: This file defines the Currency model class within the OpenCart admin localisation module, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve currency data from the database.
external_files: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Model base class

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class for managing currency records in the database, including CRUD operations and cache management.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Creates a new currency record in the database using provided data array.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record specified by currency ID with new data.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the value of a currency identified by its code.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Deletes a currency record based on its primary key.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Fetches a currency record by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total count of currency records.
